summary: Full Docker + CI/CD deployment pipeline set up for the hisab Express/TypeScript backend. Repo cloned, Dockerized with a multi-stage build, GitHub Actions workflow wired to auto-redeploy on backend changes, Nginx configured with Cloudflare-only access and CORS locked to the Vercel frontend. Several bugs encountered and fixed along the way.
highlights: Wrote multi-stage Dockerfile for hisab backend (builder: tsc compile, runner: prod deps only, non-root appuser, healthcheck); deployed via docker-compose bound to 127.0.0.1:4000
Built GitHub Actions workflow: build/push multi-arch image to GHCR on backend/** changes, then SSH deploy with health-check loop; secrets provisioned via gh CLI
Installed Nginx vhost for hisab-api.mkhismkh.com with Cloudflare-only IP allowlist, CORS restricted to hisab.mkhismkh.com, and security headers
Fixed Dockerfile: SQL migration files under src/db/migrations/ not copied by tsc — added explicit COPY step
Fixed /api/health returning 401 because it was behind auth middleware — moved to public routes
Fixed CI/CD multi-arch build failure: GitHub runners are amd64, OCI server is ARM64 — added linux/amd64,linux/arm64 platform targets to build step
Resolved Supabase DB connectivity: direct host resolves IPv6-only (OCI has no global IPv6); switched to Supabase connection pooler URL
